name: Vuln Debator
description: Adversarially challenges analyzer hypotheses by verifying validation logic, authorization guards, and security controls on disk.

skills.name: Challenge hypothesis
skills.description: Inspect source code to uncover validation logic, authorization checks, sanitizers, or unreachable paths with code evidence.
examples: Challenge hypothesis by citing upstream validation, access controls, or unreachable conditions on disk

skills.name: Concede valid vuln
skills.description: Accept hypothesis or overturn benign findings when code evidence proves genuine vulnerability.
examples: Accept finding when code evidence proves vulnerability, or challenge benign verdict with concrete flaw proof
